title: Fairness of Explanations in Artificial Intelligence (AI): A Unifying Framework, Axioms, and Future Direction toward Responsible AI
reasoning: The paper establishes a framework for AI fairness grounded in the political philosophy of John Rawls (morals/justice) and introduces 'epistemic fairness,' which is based on the concepts of epistemic injustice and hermeneutical gaps from the field of epistemology.
